svg.text: Freeze changes and take a logical backup
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
APP01 · osTicket Admin Panel, IIS Manager and MariaDB command prompt
Tell practice users the desk is offline, set Helpdesk Status to Offline, then stop only the
PracticeHelpdesk pool so no web writes occur during the backup.
Create a protected folder such as D:\LabBackups only if D: exists; otherwise choose another
protected non-web folder. Run mariadb-dump from the installed MariaDB bin folder using
--result-file. Never redirect binary or dump data through Windows PowerShell’s default text
The command prompts for the database administrator password. Confirm exit code 0, a nonempty
SQL file and a backup record. Keep database access local.
Check: A consistent logical SQL dump exists outside the website folder.
